message.content: {"0": {"original": "A Swedish court sentenced four TPB administrators to prison and damages for a 20", "rephrased": "A Swedish court has sentenced four administrators of the file-sharing site The Pirate Bay to prison terms and ordered them to pay damages for copyright infringement, establishing a legal precedent that the site's operators now intend to challenge through an appeal.", "summary": "A Swedish court sentenced four TPB administrators to prison and damages for copyright infringement."}, "1": {"original": "The court has found four individuals guilty of accessory to breaching copyright", "rephrased": "The Stockholm district court has found four individuals guilty of accessory to breaching copyright laws and sentenced each to one year in prison, a ruling that the site's operators subsequently dismissed as a media stunt.", "summary": "The Stockholm district court sentenced four individuals to one year in prison for breaching copyright laws."}, "2": {"original": "Refuses to shut down or halt file sharing, calling the verdict a media stunt.", "rephrased": "The operators of The Pirate Bay refuse to shut down the site or halt file sharing operations, characterizing the recent Swedish court verdict as a theater for the media and stating they will not pay the ordered damages.", "summary": "TPB operators refuse to shut down the site or pay damages, calling the verdict a media stunt."}, "3": {"original": "The trial lasted two weeks and concluded on March 2, involving lawsuits from maj", "rephrased": "The trial involving lawsuits from major studios like Sony, Warner Bros., and Columbia Pictures lasted two weeks and concluded on March 2, with The Pirate Bay expected to file an appeal against the verdict.", "summary": "The trial involving major studios lasted two weeks and concluded on March 2."}}
